item.title: Sauce Katsu-don: Fukui's Worcestershire-Dipped Cutlet Rice Bowl — Guide
item.description: Sauce katsu-don is Fukui’s distinctive take on katsudon, diverging from the egg-simmered version common across most of Japan by instead dipping a freshly fried, crisp pork cutlet in a tangy, sweet-savoury Worcestershire-style sauce and laying it directly over a bed of rice, without egg. This approach keeps the cutlet’s crunchy exterior intact rather than softening it, and the dish is a local staple served at restaurants throughout Fukui, with some establishments claiming to be the original creators of the style.
